title: Wgpu Theme Cursor Parity
description: Wgpu renderer cursor parity with React: theme-aware custom SVG cursors (selectable, grab, resize, text, etc.) applied to canvas based on hit targets and drag state.
summary: Added independent print technology: expl3 LaTeX framework (semio.cls + modular .sty packages) with Tectonic prebuilt binary bootstrap, token/font generation from ui/styling/tokens.json, report/paper/flyer templates, and Zukunft Bau report family (forschungsbericht, zwischenbericht, kompaktbericht). Registered nx targets, launch.json dev/build entries, and workspace package.
